cues.prompt: One isolated cozy creature-care game menu move: a tiny soft hardwood bead tick with one delicate warm tonal fleck. Extremely short, tactile, friendly, and dry. Exactly one cue. No electronic beep, no music, no ambience, no voice, no long reverb.

One isolated cozy creature-care confirmation: a tactile hardwood button click followed immediately by two friendly short glass-and-wood sparkle notes rising gently. Compact, warm, and dry. Exactly one cue. No music bed, no ambience, no voice, no long reverb, no harsh electronic beep.

One isolated successful fantasy-creature training action: four quick playful hardwood percussion notes rising in pitch and intensity, ending with a tiny natural chime accent. Compact, warm, rhythmic, and original. No voice, no creature call, no music bed, no drums, no ambience, no long reverb.

One isolated cute fantasy creature battle hit: a clear padded soft-body impact, small paw or fist contact, and one tiny magical spark crack. Punchy and readable but gentle, close dry Foley. Exactly one hit. No whoosh, no repeated impact, no pain cry, no voice, no bones, no music, no explosion.

One concise cheerful fantasy-creature victory flourish: five rising warm celesta, wooden pluck, and tiny bell notes with a sparkling resolved final accent. Original, cozy, memorable, and cleanly ending. No drums, no full music bed, no voice, no creature call, no crowd, no long reverb.

One concise gentle fantasy-creature setback cue: four descending muted hardwood and soft marimba notes, disappointed but kind, ending quietly without melodrama. Original warm studio sound. No voice, no creature cry, no drums, no music bed, no dark cinematic boom, no long reverb.

mastering.description: one-shots use onset trim, exact duration fit, equal-power mono downmix, DC removal, 24 Hz high-pass, short edge fades, and 4x reconstructed-peak gain staging; loops use stable-window selection, equal-value smoothstep boundary preparation, exact duration fit, and reconstructed-peak gain staging

clap.purpose: candidate triage only; not a substitute for listening
clap.reproducibility: normalized candidate score arrays identical across two independent runs

selection.pilot_policy: retain any user-auditioned pilot candidates recorded for this pack
selection.quality_priority: new packs rank semantic and signal validity ahead of waveform diversity; correlation remains recorded for audit
